description:
A complete loan and savings calculator that works entirely offline.

LOANS
Calculate EMI, or solve for the amount, rate or tenure you can actually afford. See the full amortisation schedule month by month, with a chart of how each year splits between principal and interest. Model part payments, advance EMIs, a moratorium, or a change in rate, and see what each one saves. Compare two offers side by side including processing fees. Save your loans and track payments against them.

SAVINGS AND INVESTMENTS
Fixed and recurring deposits, PPF, SIP, SWP, STP, lumpsum, and SIP adjusted for inflation. Simple and compound interest, and what inflation does to a sum over time.

EVERYDAY TOOLS
GST, currency conversion, percentages, discounts, tip and bill splitting, fuel cost for a trip, the difference between two dates, and age.

BUILT TO STAY OUT OF YOUR WAY
No account. No ads. No tracking. Every figure is computed on your device and stored only on your device. Switch between rupees, dollars, pounds, euros and more, with digit grouping that matches. Export any schedule as a PDF. Full dark mode.
promotionalText: Work out any loan EMI, see exactly how much of each payment is interest, and find out what a part payment really saves you. No account, no ads, nothing leaves your phone.
